selection.selection_reason: Prespecified complete sequential fix-round runs after backend regression verification: same seeded 200-patient E1 cohort, 30 scripts x 5 E2, validation of those E2 outputs, three E3 configurations x 30 scripts, and mock/real E4. No model, prompt, temperature, threshold or patient-selection tuning. Each run and each E3 child passed the 30-patient/521-resource preflight.
selection.excluded_runs_policy: All recovered runs remain inventoried in asset_provenance.json; smoke runs are not pooled into the formal cohort.
selection.load_caveat: Both selected E4 modes use the final backend v0.18.0 fix round and replay the selected new E2 run. Mock and real workloads still differ in level and patient pool; descriptive local observations, not national capacity. Earlier mock used a pre-final backend and a different replay source, so old/new results are not paired comparisons.
